vocabulary.meaning_en: from now and continuing up to a time, then it stops
the same as until, a little informal
a short form of until (the apostrophe shows letters are missing)
vocabulary.note_ar: الفاصلة العليا تدل على حذف un

vocabulary.meaning_en: at or before a time in the future (a deadline)
vocabulary.meaning_ar: في موعد أقصاه / قبل أو عند
vocabulary.example: Please finish the report by Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the same as by, but used before a subject + verb
vocabulary.example: By the time I get home, dinner will be ready.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last time or date to finish something
a preposition that talks about time (at, on, in, by, until)
a picture of two circles that shows what is the same and what is different
vocabulary.example: The Venn diagram shows what by and until share.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cross or meet each other
the situation that helps you understand the meaning
vocabulary.example: You need context to choose by or until.

vocabulary.meaning_en: from the past to this moment (and now it has changed)
vocabulary.note_ar: مثلها: till now / up to this point
vocabulary.note_en: Same as: till now / up to this point.
vocabulary.example: Up until now, the weather was bad. Now it's sunny.

fine_lines.title: until vs by
fine_lines.explanation_ar: until = الحدث يستمر من الآن حتى وقت معيّن ثم يتوقف (استمرار). by = لا يهمنا الاستمرار، فقط نقطة نهائية في المستقبل: قبلها أو عندها (موعد نهائي).
fine_lines.explanation_en: until = the action continues from now up to a time, then stops (continuation). by = we don't care about continuing; it's just an end point in the future: at or before that time (a deadline).

examples.sentence: You have until May 13th to bring the book back.
You must bring the book back by May 13th.

fine_lines.title: until vs till vs 'til
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد. until الأكثر رسمية، till غير رسمية، و'til اختصار. الفرق في الكتابة فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning. Until is the most formal, till is informal, 'til is a short form. Only the spelling is different.

fine_lines.title: by vs bye vs buy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ثلاث كلمات تُنطق بنفس الطريقة: by حرف جر، bye تحية وداع (goodbye)، buy فعل بمعنى يشتري.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Three words with the same sound: by (preposition), bye (short for goodbye), buy (verb: to pay for something).

expressions.meaning_en: You have time from now to that time.
expressions.example: You have until Friday to hand in your essay.

expressions.phrase: By the time I get home, ...
expressions.meaning_en: At or before the moment I arrive.
expressions.example: By the time I get home, the children will be asleep.
You've been very helpful up until now.

expressions.phrase: It always seems impossible until it's done.
expressions.meaning_ar: يبدو الأمر دائمًا مستحيلًا حتى يتم إنجازه.
expressions.meaning_en: A famous quote by Nelson Mandela.
expressions.example: Don't give up. It always seems impossible until it's done.

grammar.title: Until = continue, then stop
grammar.explanation_ar: until + وقت: الحدث يستمر حتى ذلك الوقت. كثيرًا ما يأتي مع أفعال الاستمرار (-ing) أو أفعال مثل wait, stay, work.
grammar.explanation_en: until + time: the action continues up to that time. It often goes with continuous verbs (-ing) or verbs like wait, stay, work.
examples: I will be studying English until dinner time.
I'll wait until 6 p.m., then I'm leaving.

grammar.title: By = deadline in the future
grammar.explanation_ar: by + وقت: الحدث يحدث عند هذا الوقت أو قبله. غالبًا مع will / must / have to. by the time + فاعل + فعل.
grammar.explanation_en: by + time: the action happens at or before that time. Often with will / must / have to. by the time + subject + verb.
examples: I have to finish my website by June 1st.
We have to leave by 8 a.m.
I will be finished work by 5 o'clock tomorrow.

grammar.title: Context: arriving or leaving?
grammar.explanation_ar: أحيانًا تصح الكلمتان، والمعنى يتغير: I will be at the hospital by 5 p.m. = سأصل قبل الخامسة. I will be at the hospital until 5 p.m. = أنا هناك وسأغادر في الخامسة.
grammar.explanation_en: Sometimes both are correct but the meaning changes: I will be at the hospital by 5 p.m. = I will arrive by 5. I will be at the hospital until 5 p.m. = I'm there and I'll leave at 5.
examples: She'll be at the office by 12. (arriving)
She'll be at the office until 12. (leaving at 12)

questions.question: I have to finish my project ___ June 1st.
I will be studying ___ dinner time.
He's late. I'll wait ___ 6 p.m., then I'm leaving.
___ I get home, dinner will be ready.
questions.explanation_ar: قبل فاعل + فعل: by the time.
questions.explanation_en: Before subject + verb: by the time.

questions.question: "I'll be at the hospital until 5 p.m." means ___.
choices: I'm there now and will leave at 5.
questions.explanation_ar: until = سأبقى ثم أغادر في الخامسة.
questions.explanation_en: Until = I stay, then leave at 5.

questions.question: Which is the short form of "until"?
Which word is a verb meaning "to pay for something"?
What is a "deadline"?
choices: the last time to finish something
questions.explanation_en: The last time to finish something.

questions.question: "The weather was bad up until now." What happened?
questions.explanation_ar: up until now = تغيّر الأمر الآن.
questions.explanation_en: Up until now = it changed now.
